data.content_ref: inline:Add a 'standing residue' report: after the grounded extension, mark an undecided node as standing if it has no path of length <= k to an accepted defender, computed by a bounded BFS from the accepted set (O(V+E) for fixed k). This is an auxiliary, conservative 'permanently suspended' signal that does not enter the fixpoint, so determinism and polynomial cost hold. The causal mechanism is structural isolation from any accepted defense; it helps operators distinguish nodes that might become accepted after new evidence from those that are stuck under the current graph. It is deliberately atypical because it is a diagnostic overlay rather than a semantic expansion, and the bounded-depth parameter must be justified empirically.
